# Vendored dependencies

Dependencies are checked into Git so a normal clone or source ZIP contains the
build inputs. CMake does not fetch packages during configuration. The supported
Windows build uses static libraries and bundled zlib; the MSVC redistributable
runtime is copied into the standalone Release package.

| Dependency | Version recorded in this snapshot | Upstream | Notice |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GLFW | 3.4.0 | https://github.com/glfw/glfw | `glfw/LICENSE.md` |
| Assimp | 6.0.2 | https://github.com/assimp/assimp | `assimp/LICENSE` and `assimp/contrib/` notices |
| GLAD | Generated by 0.1.36, OpenGL 3.3 core | https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad | `glad/LICENSE`, `glad/include/KHR/khrplatform.h` |
| Dear ImGui | 1.92.7, docking-enabled snapshot | https://github.com/ocornut/imgui | `imgui/LICENSE.txt` |
| ImGuiFileDialog | v0.6.9 WIP | https://github.com/aiekick/ImGuiFileDialog | `ImGuiFileDialog/LICENSE` and bundled notices |
| GLM | 0.9.8.5 | https://github.com/g-truc/glm | `glm/copying.txt` (MIT option) |
| stb_image | See the version in `stb/stb_image.h` | https://github.com/nothings/stb | License embedded at the end of the header |

These are versions reported by local headers/CMake, not a claim that every file
matches an unmodified upstream release. Original upstream commit IDs were not
recorded; the hpRenderer Git commit pins the exact vendored contents. When next
updating a dependency, record its upstream commit and preserve/test local patches.
GLM/GLAD license files were restored from their matching upstream version tags.

## Local changes that must survive an update

- `assimp/code/AssetLib/MMD/MMDImporter.cpp`: preserve PMX two-sided material flags.
- `ImGuiFileDialog/ImGuiFileDialog.cpp`: use UTF-8-aware filesystem metadata paths.
  The application also compiles the library with `USE_STD_FILESYSTEM`.
- Project-level model tests use selected Assimp FBX/glTF fixtures. Do not remove
  `assimp/test/` without relocating the required fixtures and their provenance.

Run CPU tests and the opt-in GPU tests after dependency changes. A future
FetchContent/submodule migration must pin revisions, carry patches, and retain a
self-contained source distribution; it is not required for this portfolio build.

Third-party code and models retain their own licenses. In particular, Assimp's
`test/models-nonbsd` is explicitly excluded from its blanket BSD license. The
runtime package does not include Assimp test models or local user downloads.
